An '''unidentified protocol droid''' was in the service of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seven Flames]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was responsible for debriefing a [[Alliance Diplomatic Corps|Rebel diplomatic team]] after their [[Primitive Sentient Protection and Alliance, Operation 265-A: Karra|mission]].
